justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/visitor/HashCodeVisitor.java` (746 lines, 103 `visit` overloads, plus only a singleton and `hashCode(Node)` entrypoint), `javaparser-core-generators/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/generator/core/visitor/HashCodeVisitorGenerator.java`, and `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/visitor/NoCommentHashCodeVisitor.java`. The class is large but highly cohesive: every method performs the same hash-code accumulation role for a different AST node type, and the generator/meta-model code shows this breadth is intentional and mechanically produced rather than evidence of multiple unrelated responsibilities or obvious separable abstractions.
